This is calculated as the number of views that skipped your reel during the first 3 seconds divided by the number of initial views. An initial view is when your reel starts to play for the first time in a reel session.

data.name: views
data.title: Views
data.description: The number of times your reels was played or displayed.

data.name: reach
data.title: Accounts reached
data.description: The number of unique accounts that have seen this reel, at least once. Reach is different from impressions, which may include multiple views of your reel by the same accounts. This metric is estimated.

data.name: saved
data.title: Saved
data.description: The number of saves of your reel.

data.name: shares
data.title: Shares
data.description: The number of shares of your reel.

data.name: likes
data.title: Likes
data.description: The number of likes on your reel.

data.name: comments
data.title: Comments
data.description: The number of comments on your reel.

data.name: total_interactions
data.title: Reels interactions
data.description: The number of likes, saves, comments and shares on your reels minus the number of unlikes, unsaves and deleted comments.
